reviewed_by: Claude Code after independent subagent root-cause validation and scratch-Core reproduction
reason: A storage dispatch retry hands its dispatch to the running dispatch loop and waits at most RETRY_WAIT_SECONDS for it, instead of running the whole N x 15 s scan inline on the project's work lane. Selected: the new bounded-retry regression and the existing retry routes, plus the storage integration suite. test_an_expired_owner_with_storage_work_is_recovered is excluded: it already fails on origin/main f3045ee.
exclusions: No UI, native or Playwright layer: no interface change. Not reproduced end to end on a scratch Core (it needs an enrolled storage source with many failing incident dispatches); covered by the focused route regression.
